title: CurseCore Field: Core Loop
summary: Detect, monitor, prepare, cleanse, and verify each curse state change.

blocks.title: Detect
blocks.body: Identify the curse category, stage, severity, visibility, symptoms, and available cleansing methods.

blocks.title: Prepare
blocks.body: Gather the ritual, catalyst, or diagnostic route before the curse reaches a worse stage.

blocks.title: Verify
blocks.body: After cleansing, confirm the player data changed and that related mission or event hooks recorded the result.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
